responsibility: Tests parser-adjacent token stream behavior used by parsing, covering token stream construction, concatenation, equality, emptiness, and punctuation gluing semantics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the general parser tests in `parser/tests.rs` and the AST-rewrite tests in `parser/mut_visit/tests.rs`, this file focuses narrowly on token stream operations used around parsing, such as concatenation, equality, emptiness, and punctuation gluing.
